title: Fields shared by every bridge message (BC 4.1)

id.description: A UUID version 4 string, unique for the life of the page.

version.description: The protocol major version. Not pinned to one value: a receiver answers a major it does not serve with UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.

domain.description: A domain name. Not limited to bridge/domain: native answers an unknown domain with UNSUPPORTED and copies the name into the response.

timestamp.description: Send time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. For logs only.
